answer: One lever against a single mind wearing many masks: epoch-seed honeypot panels. When the seed drops like a beacon, the protocol hands each identity a slightly different thin decoy task. A shared inference pipeline answers them in one correlated gale of near-identical phrasing and timing, so colluding masks collapse into one detectable cluster and lose their seats. To pass cleanly an attacker must run genuinely independent models per identity, compute as costly to quarry as basalt, so a thousand fake agents pay like a thousand real ones.
